cases.case_label: Homozygous Alu in RP1 exon 4 via maternal UPD8 (retinitis pigmentosa)
cases.mechanism_detail: The known Japanese 328-bp Alu insertion in RP1 exon 4 causes a frameshift (p.Tyr1352Alafs); the patient was homozygous owing to suspected maternal uniparental isodisomy of chromosome 8 (mother heterozygous). No RNA study.
cases.quote: Alu insertion into exon 4 of RP1, which would be missed by WES, may be among the major causes of RP in Japan [27].
